- `HEAD` patterns are registered beside each `GET` pattern, because a `GET` pattern otherwise answers `HEAD` with the `GET` status; every other method gets the mux's 405, and unknown paths (including `/accounts/`, which no wildcard matches) get a 404.
- Edge exposure is answered with `ReadHeaderTimeout`/`ReadTimeout`/`WriteTimeout`/`IdleTimeout`, `MaxHeaderBytes`, `MaxHeaderValueCount`, and `DisableClientPriority`. Starting and stopping stays with the caller, as documented.
